================================================================================
  BANKING PLATFORM — LOCAL CREDENTIALS
  Project: golang-banking-platform
  Environment: local / docker-desktop
================================================================================

Each stack owns its own .env file — see HOWTORUN.md for setup instructions.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DATASOURCE  →  datasource/.env
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  MySQL
    Host         : localhost:3306
    Database     : banking_db
    Root User    : root
    Root Password: rootpassword
    User         : banking_user
    Password     : bankingpassword

  PostgreSQL (superuser / bootstrap)
    Host         : localhost:5432
    Database     : banking_db
    User         : banking_user
    Password     : bankingpassword

  MongoDB
    Host         : localhost:27017
    User         : admin
    Password     : adminpassword
    Database     : banking_db
    Connection   : mongodb://admin:adminpassword@localhost:27017/?directConnection=true&authSource=admin

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PLATFORM  →  platform/.env
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  Redis (token store, session cache, rate limiting)
    Host         : localhost:6379
    Password     : redispassword

  Flipt (feature flags — optional per service)
    UI           : http://localhost:8082
    gRPC         : localhost:9000
    REST         : http://localhost:8082/api/v1

  NATS (async messaging — optional per service)
    Client       : localhost:4222
    Dashboard    : http://localhost:8222

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  POSTGRESQL SERVICE USERS  →  datasource/postgres/01_create_users_and_databases.sql
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  auth-svc
    Database     : banking_auth
    User         : auth_svc
    Password     : auth_svc_pass_local

  account-svc
    Database     : banking_accounts
    User         : account_svc
    Password     : account_svc_pass_local

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  auth-svc  →  services/auth-svc/.env
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  HTTP Port      : 8080
  DB_HOST  : localhost
  DB_PORT  : 5432
  DB_NAME   : banking_auth
  DB_USER   : auth_svc
  DB_PASSWORD: auth_svc_pass_local

  JWT_PRIVATE_KEY_B64 : <freshly generated — see services/auth-svc/.env>
  JWT_PUBLIC_KEY_B64  : <freshly generated — see services/auth-svc/.env>
  JWT_ISSUER          : banking-platform
  JWT_ACCESS_TOKEN_TTL : 15m
  JWT_REFRESH_TOKEN_TTL: 168h

  OTEL_ENABLED               : true
  OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT: localhost:4317
  OTEL_SAMPLING_RATE         : 1.0
  RATE_LIMIT_RPS             : 500
  RATE_LIMIT_BURST           : 1000

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  account-svc  →  services/account-svc/.env
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  HTTP Port      : 8081
  DB_HOST  : localhost
  DB_PORT  : 5432
  DB_NAME   : banking_accounts
  DB_USER   : account_svc
  DB_PASSWORD: account_svc_pass_local

  JWT_PUBLIC_KEY_B64 : <copy from auth-svc — must match>
  JWT_ISSUER         : banking-platform

  OTEL_ENABLED               : true
  OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT: localhost:4317
  OTEL_SAMPLING_RATE         : 1.0
  RATE_LIMIT_RPS             : 1000
  RATE_LIMIT_BURST           : 2000

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MONITORING  →  monitoring/.env
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  Grafana
    URL          : http://localhost:3000
    User         : admin
    Password     : admin

  Discord Webhook URL: <set in monitoring/.env — gitignored>

  Prometheus     : http://localhost:9090
  Jaeger UI      : http://localhost:16686
  Alertmanager   : http://localhost:9093
  Loki           : http://localhost:3100
  Discord Relay  : http://localhost:9094

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  APPLICATION USERS  (seeded via migration)
  Source: services/auth-svc/migrations/
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  Admin
    Email        : admin@banking.local
    Password     : Admin@12345
    Role         : ADMIN

  Teller
    Email        : teller@banking.local
    Password     : Teller@12345
    Role         : TELLER

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  JWT SUBJECT ENCRYPTION KEY (AES-256)
  Must be identical across all services that read the subject claim
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  account-svc
  JWT_PUBLIC_KEY_B64 : 
  JWT_ISSUER : banking-platform
  JWT_SUBJECT_ENCRYPTION_KEY : V0h87CI8nIfSOi7f4Nu0AlDY/ykFW0Kacjh+fZglnME=

  auth-svc
  JWT_PRIVATE_KEY_
  JWT_PUBLIC_KEY_
  JWT_ISSUER=banking-platform
  ACCESS_TOKEN_TTL=15m
  REFRESH_TOKEN_TTL=168h
  JWT_SUBJECT_ENCRYPTION_KEY=V0h87CI8nIfSOi7f4Nu0AlDY/ykFW0Kacjh+fZglnME=

  To generate a new key:
    openssl rand -base64 32
